name: Surkea
source:
Surkea is a visual novel featuring four young girls in class at their typical Japanese school.

Part of Eora's Sugar and Massacre universe, coming soon!

We made this short project in two weeks as part of Ren'Py Jam 2018!

[From [url=https://somnova-studios.itch.io/surkea]Itch.io[/url]]
